main_text.l: dinum, exempli gratia, definitio lineæ, trianguli
quadranguli, &c.
Postulata siue Ætemata sunt talia principia,
quæ negari aut conuelli neque possunt nec debent;
interim tamen vt tanto rectius Geometra doce-
at, petit & postulat ea sibi à discipulo seu audito-
re concedi.
Et hæc postulata Geometrica sunt quatuor:
Primum Postulatum est: A quouis puncto in
quoduis punctum lineam ducere.

l.i: f. Punctum, vt Pythagoreis placet, est vnitas quæ situm
obtinet. Vnitas vero punctum est, quod situ vacat.

main_text.l: Secundum Postulat.est; Rectam lineam ter-
minatam continuo perducere quoufque velis.
Tertium Postulatum est: Ex quouis centro &
interuallo circulum producere.
Quartum Postulatum est: Quacunque ma-
gnitudine data sumi posse aliam vel maiorem
vel minorem.
Id est. Nunquam potest dari quantitas tam magna,
quæ maior fieri nō possit, &nunq̃ quantitas tam parua,
quæ

page.notes: Diagrams I, II and III are line figures with points labelled α, β, γ, δ, ε; they are not transcribed as text. Catchword "quæ" at the lower right of the last line is treated as a catchword. The figure "3" at the right margin beside diagram III is a printed number and is uncertain. Italic note text is set in small type and is marked as a foot note.
